item.title: Costco is the anti-Amazon
item.description:
📝 Two companies have emerged with ideal-type business models that dramatize the different economies at each end of this spectrum: Amazon and Costco. While most retailers today assume that consumers want ever greater assortment, Costco’s popularity speaks to a countervailing desire for less choice. In other words, when a Costco store receives a shipment of a particular item from a supplier, it is often going to sell every unit in that shipment in less than a month, thanks to its scale and the simple fact that that particular item is going to be the only variety in store.
🔗 Read more: https://phenomenalworld.org/analysis/the-anti-amazon/

item.title: Show HN: Mcpsnoop – Wireshark for MCP (transparent proxy and live TUI)
item.description:
📝 A transparent proxy that shows every real tool call between your AI client and your MCP servers, live in your terminal. It never sees the traffic between your client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code) and your server. Wrap your server command with it and watch every JSON-RPC frame in a live terminal UI as your real client and server talk.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/kerlenton/mcpsnoop
